dboxTimeline.text: Ten old spheres. Paine's recordings, every one.
Together they opened a door in the ravine.
Inside, the pyreflies remembered someone else
A boy, a machine, and a song cut short.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: This place is dangerous. Stay close.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Um, the glowy things are staring.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: They're not just pyreflies. They're... feelings.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Theirs. I know those shapes.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: That's Baralai! Isn't it...?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: What's left of him.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Gippal? He'd never pick a fight with me.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: This one would.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: His pattern's gone. Watch everything now!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Nooj too. All three of them.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: ...Of course. He'd go first.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Enough. Let them rest.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: We're out! Everybody's out, right?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Those weren't them. It was Shuyin, feeling through them.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: So the squad didn't hate each other.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Paine... are you okay?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Two years I thought they chose it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Baralai's still carrying him. I'll get him back.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Okay. Team hug. Paine, you're in the middle.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: No.
